summary.text: Danny Verdin is a Republican from Laurens who represents Senate District 9 (Greenville, Laurens and Union Counties) in the South Carolina Senate, where he has served since 2001 and chairs the Medical Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: Verdin was born May 9, 1964, at England Air Force Base in Alexandria, Louisiana, graduated from Bob Jones University with a B.A. in 1986, and owns Verdin's Farm & Garden Center.
He was agriculture and natural resources advisor in the Governor's Office from 1987 to 1989.

In the Senate he chaired the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee from 2007 to 2018, has chaired Medical Affairs since 2018, and was Majority Whip for the Senate Republican Caucus from 2011 to 2013.
His page also lists service on the Finance and Transportation committees and legislator-of-the-year recognitions from the South Carolina Farm Bureau and other groups.
